caption:
Same $1,000 purchase, two ways to pay. 💸

Pay in full: $0 interest.
Carry it on a ~22% APR card, paying only minimums: it can take well over a year, costing a few hundred dollars extra.

Exact amounts depend on your card. Check your own terms.

Which one are you aiming for?
